+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+
+from slatepress.frontmatter import parse_front_matter
+from slatepress.markdown import render_markdown
+from slatepress.html import render_page
+
+
+def build_site(source_dir: Path, output_dir: Path) -> list[str]:
+    """Converts Markdown files (.md) to HTML using front matter, markdown, and html modules,
+    recursing into subdirectories, skipping any file or directory whose name begins with
+    an underscore or a dot, and copying any non-Markdown file unchanged.
+
+    Returns a list of output file paths written as strings.
+    """
+    source_dir = Path(source_dir)
+    output_dir = Path(output_dir)
+
+    written_files: list[str] = []
+
+    if not source_dir.exists() or not source_dir.is_dir():
+        return written_files
+
+    # Ensure output directory exists if there's work to do or even if empty
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+    for item in source_dir.iterdir():
+        if item.name.startswith(("_", ".")):
+            continue
+
+        rel_path = item.relative_to(source_dir)
+        dest_path = output_dir / rel_path
+
+        if item.is_dir():
+            # Recurse into subdirectory
+            written_files.extend(build_site(item, dest_path))
+        elif item.is_file():
+            if item.suffix.lower() == ".md":
+                dest_path = dest_path.with_suffix(".html")
+                dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+                content = item.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+                metadata, body = parse_front_matter(content)
+                html_body = render_markdown(body)
+                page_html = render_page(metadata, html_body)
+
+                dest_path.write_text(page_html, encoding="utf-8")
+                written_files.append(str(dest_path))
+            else:
+                dest_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                shutil.copy2(item, dest_path)
+                written_files.append(str(dest_path))
+
+    return sorted(written_files)
